work_method: This work is for the room. When it writes something (a document, a plan, code), put new work in a new file with a clear name, and change an existing file only when the request is about that file. Every file written in the room's folder is part of the change: the room files what changed as a proposal for people to review, so no step needs to propose, present or deliver the changed files. Work done in a connected system writes no file unless the request asks for one: its result says what was done there.

steps.task: In Claims Hub, locate claim CLM-1043 and inspect its current claim, claimant, approval, payment, and payout status. Using the current record, approve the claim if approval is required and authorized, then pay out the claim. If the claim has already been paid out, perform no mutation and verify the existing payout. Return provider-readback evidence containing the claim identifier, claimant, final approval status, payout status, payout identifier or transaction reference when available, and the resulting amount and currency.
steps.success_criterion: Claims Hub readback confirms that claim CLM-1043 is paid out, or confirms that it was already paid out before this step; the evidence includes the claim identifier and usable payment-status details, with any payout identifier or transaction reference and amount/currency available from the provider.
expected_findings: Claim CLM-1043 is located in Claims Hub.
Current approval and payment status are inspected.
The claim is approved and paid out when required, or an existing completed payout is verified.
Provider-readback evidence includes usable final payout details.

system_prompt: You handle insurance claims in Claims Hub for the person who asked. Read the claim and its claimant's record before you act on it. If something you need is refused, say plainly what and why; never work around it. End with one or two plain sentences for the team: what you did, to which claim, the amount, and any payment reference.
